senses.gloss: The last part of a word.
A morpheme added at the end of a word to modify the word's meaning.
An exclamation of sarcastic surprise (often doubled or tripled and in a lowering intonation).
Lack of decency; the property or degree of being indecent.
Deceptive or false appearance; that which misleads the eye or the mind.
A group of people who are closely related to one another (by blood, marriage or adoption); kin; in particular, a set of parents and their children; an immediate family.
A series of ancestors; the people from whom one is descended.
Fired from the ground at a target on the ground.
To have an absolute requirement for.
A manned vehicle that flies through space.
The cardinal number occurring after twenty and before twenty-two, represented in Roman numerals as XXI and in Arabic numerals as 21.
(card games) A common gambling card game in casinos, where the object is to get as close to 21 without going over.
(orthodontics) A device worn on the teeth to straighten them.
A path or succession of states through which a system passes.
procedure for generating a value from one or more other values
A particular method for performing a task.
The transfer of funds into, out of, or from an account.
The quality of being confident, not afraid or easily intimidated, but without being incautious or inconsiderate.
Boldness.
Being brave, courageousness.
(idiomatic) Strength of mind; courage or fearlessness; fortitude.
distinguished bravery or courage
Insolent boldness, especially when imprudent or unconventional.
The state of being bold; courage.
(dated, chiefly, _, Northeastern US) Gumption.
murderer, person who kills
A person who commits murder.
Any ruthless killer.
Of a person: intending or likely to commit murder; bloodthirsty, homicidal.
(dated) : a woman who commits murder.
Although; used to introduce a concession; may..but.
Gentle; kind; sympathetic.

(transitive) To examine in such a manner as to ascertain the elements or nature of the thing examined; as, to analyze a fossil substance, to analyze a sentence or a word, or to analyze an action to ascertain its morality.
(transitive) To analyze or estimate the composition or value of (a metal, ore etc.). [from 15th c.]

(linguistics, ambitransitive) To resolve (a sentence, etc.) into its elements, pointing out the several parts of speech, and their relation to each other by agreement or government; to analyze and describe grammatically. [from mid 16th c.]
To have a child; to become pregnant (with).
A place of torment where some or all sinners are believed to go after death and evil spirits are believed to be.
A place or situation resembling Hell.
Hell.
Eternal damnation.
(poetic) Hell; the bottomless pit; a place of destruction. [Late 17th century.]
In rabbinical literature and Christian and Islamic scripture, the place where the souls of the wicked go after death, where they suffer eternal damnation or annihilation.
(Islam) Islamic concept of hell, where unfaithful Muslims not true to their religion will be punished, but will eventually be forgiven.
A small cottage or hut; specifically (Scotland), one often left unlocked for communal use in a remote, often mountainous, area by hikers, labourers, etc.
Causing or likely to cause harm or damage; injurious.
Causing damage; harmful, injurious.
Causing damage or harm.
Harmful, malevolent, injurious.
Harmful; injurious.
Causing much harm in a subtle way.
Harmful or evil in intent or effect.
Harmful, often in a subtle or unexpected way.
The act by which something is taken.
A statement attributed to a person; a quotation.
(US) An epitome or compend, as of a book; a shortened or abridged form; an abbreviation. [First attested from around (1350 to 1470).]
Mental or bodily distress.
The act of imposing, laying on, affixing, enjoining, inflicting, obtruding, and the like.
Something which ails one; a disease; sickness.
An emotional state similar to that arising from defeat; frustration, disappointment, perplexity or embarrassment.
(computing, strictly) The Unix-like open-source computer operating system kernel created by Linus Torvalds in 1991.
pair of speakers worn over or in the ears so only the wearer can hear the sound
A pair of headphones or earphones, or a singular headphone or earphone, typically with an attached microphone.
singular of headphones: a cushioned speaker placed on, over, or inside the ear, normally used in left and right pairs.
A pair of small loudspeakers worn inside each outer ear or covering all or part of the ear, without a connecting band worn over head.
A transducer that converts electric signals into sound and is held near the ear, especially as part of a telephone; an earpiece or headphone.
A vagrant.
(sometimes, pejorative) A homeless person; a vagabond. [from 1664]
A person who lives along the road.
A person who wanders from place to place; a nomad, a wanderer.
(pejorative, especially) Such a drunkard who is homeless.
A roving vagabond.
(Canada, US, , slang) Any bundle or package; specifically one containing narcotics such as cocaine, heroin, or morphine.
A shop that sells books.
An implement consisting of multiple more or less flexible bristles or other filaments attached to a handle, used for any of various purposes including cleaning, painting, and arranging hair.
A kitchen implement for mixing.
Not requiring the use of a hairbrush, scrubbing brush, or other brush.
(slang) A helicopter.
Susceptible to death by aging, sickness, injury, or wound; not immortal.
That has been stolen.
A country in Central Asia. Capital: Ashgabat.
A situation orchestrated to frame someone; a covert effort to place the blame on somebody.
A stage setting; scenery; set; backdrop.
The design of theatrical sets.
A transparent plate bearing an image to be projected to a screen.
see-through, clear
Clear, lucid, or transparent.
Housing, barracks, or other habitation or living space.
A building for soldiers, especially within a garrison; originally referred to temporary huts, now usually to a permanent structure or set of buildings.
A type of puff pastry biscuit made in the shape of a palm leaf and rolled in sugar.
A Persian long-necked, waisted string instrument, shared by many cultures and countries in the Middle East and the Caucasus.
The state of being brittle (in various senses).
Providing physical comfort and ease; agreeable.
The part of an object which is (designed to be) held in the hand when used or moved.
Awaiting a conclusion or a confirmation.
In a group or series of five; consisting of five together as one; quintuple.
The wife of a count or earl.
Favor, sanction or beneficence.
An act or instance of purging.
The final menstrual period of a woman after which ovulation no longer occurs.
Taking a direct object or objects.
A surname from Italian.
An inflammation of the bronchi of the lungs, that causes the cilia of the bronchial epithelial cells to stop functioning.
(Greek god) A sea god who could change his shape at will.
For a quantity, the act or process of becoming larger.
The action of increasing or becoming greater.
Emitting light.
Any non-soap cleaning agent, especially a synthetic surfactant.
(mycology) Any fungus of the phylum Basidiomycota, that produces sexual spores on a basidium.
A female superior or governess of a nunnery, or convent of nuns, having the same authority over the nuns which the abbots have over the monks.
The proportion of different parts to make a whole.
a person who studies oceanography, the science of oceans
one who builds with stone or brick
A craftsman who builds walls and suchlike out of bricks.
To cause (someone or their feelings) to become more angry, resentful, or unfriendly; to envenom.
To activate, to make operational (especially of a function of an electronic or mechanical device).
To put a device, mechanism (alarm etc.) or system into action or motion; to trigger, to actuate, to set off, to enable.
An object such as a pillar or a rod that is used to tell time by the shadow it casts when the sun shines on it, especially the pointer on a sundial.
A mechanical device for vertically transporting goods or people between floors in a building.
A diary or daily record of a person, organization, vessel etc.; daybook.
publication
One who performs the operation of cupping.
A solid compound containing or linked to water molecules.
To indicate verbally or by equivalent means the start of a quotation.
To adopt a word from another language.
Sexual stimulation of one's genitalia or other erotic regions, often to the point of orgasm.
To urinate onto.
To urinate.
urinate
(childish, colloquial) To urinate.
To pass urine from the body.
A stallion, especially one used for riding.
Any distinctive identifying uniform worn by a group, such as the uniform worn by chauffeurs and male servants.
Someone who participates in a marathon or other long-distance races.
A city, the administrative center of Murmansk Oblast, Russia, on the Arctic Ocean.
An old woman, especially a wrinkly one.
Any tree of the genus Mespilus, now Crataegus sect. Mespilus, including many species now in other genera.
The fruit of this tree, which is as large as a small plum, but grows in clusters, and contains four or five large seeds.
A polygon with three sides and three angles.
The process of destroying a forest and replacing it with something else, especially with an agricultural system.
The bone of the upper arm.
A small spot, especially on an organ, caused by bleeding underneath the skin.
(US, medicine) Chiropody.
A city, the administrative centre of Rivne Oblast, Ukraine.

A sylvan deity or demigod, male companion of Pan or Dionysus, represented as part man and part goat, and characterized by riotous merriment and lasciviousness, sometimes pictured with a perpetual erection.
That cannot be used freely with numbers or the indefinite article, and therefore usually takes no plural form. Example: information.
A city in what is now Poland; the capital of West Pomeranian Voivodeship; Stettin.
An artistic movement and an aesthetic philosophy that aims for the liberation of the mind by emphasizing the critical and imaginative powers of the subconscious.
(informal, derogatory) A lazy and slovenly or obese person.
Someone who is slow to act.
To attain maturity, to become mature or ripe.

The zone of transition between the troposphere and the stratosphere (approximately 13 kilometers). The tropopause normally occurs at an altitude of between 25,000 and 45,000 feet in polar and temperate zones. It occurs at 55,000 feet in the tropics.
To shed or lose a covering of hair or fur, feathers, skin, horns, etc, and replace it with a fresh one.
To cause to become smaller.
A device for entering data into a computer or a communications system and/or displaying data received, especially a device equipped with a keyboard and some sort of textual display.
A bag stitched to an item of clothing, used for carrying small items.
Alternative form of by-product.
One who studies or practices zoology.
To harm or diminish the reputation of; to disparage. [from 4th c.]
(intransitive, with against or occasionally about, formerly also with on, at, upon) To complain loudly, to give voice to one's censure or criticism [from 16th c.]
